metadata.creator: Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd
metadata.description:
These are the files needed to play the now-offline and delisted KHUχ+DR Android game via web browsers on desktop. It will run on mobile as well, but the experience won't be fantastic as it isn't particularly optimised towards those devices. This specific version is the World Wide/English release.

The files consist of the .obb files from https://archive.org/details/khux-5.0.1-ww
As well as the .mp4 and .png files from within the APK in that same link.
Additionally, to show file replacement/modding, I have included three patches in here. One to change the version on the title screen, an adjustment to the hp and other stat bonuses you get from reaching each level (increased by 40% per level), and an alteration to the number of enemies needed to be killed to get the bonuses for each one.

To run this, simply download all of the files, open index.html in Chrome or Firefox, hit the "choose files" button and navigate to inside the Content folder that was contained in this archive and hit upload. For the rest, tinker around! You can always reset the data stored in your browsers IndexedDB.

reviews.reviewtitle: Problems gaining BP in Dark Road world levels
reviews.reviewbody:
I have tried downloading the ZIP file or from the torrent the content of the game, redownloaded everything multiple times but I have been unable to 'play' Dark Road since most of the game requires grinding in the world levels since the missions get tougher quicker than the player if you play that exclusively.

Essentially every time I end the battle in the world levels (the ones with stars) I gain 0 BP even if I had 100 stored up in the battle UI moments earlier. This happens no matter if I end the battle manually or by dying. Now this project was brought to my attention from TheGamersJoint over on YT and in the video I am fairly certain it works for him so maybe something is wrongly configured on my end, I don't know. Hence this review, if anyone has a fix please feel free to send me a mail to takethewall@yahoo.com (which I barely check but I have it for just these occasions.

Now I know that this is mostly for preservations sake and having the Web View is incredibly useful but I would like to play the game even for a little bit no matter how Auto it is.
